about: A JSON value as a tree of keys and values. Each kind of value has its own code ink, a collapsed branch previews its first entries, and an open branch ends with its closing brace on a row of its own.

depth.about: `defaultExpandedDepth` opens every branch down to a level on the first render. The value's own row is level 1, so 1 lists the keys and 3 opens each region and its zones.
depth.label: Deployment
depth.title: Opening depth

links.about: `getHref` returns an address for a leaf, and the row renders as a link to it. Each ID opens its record's page. A link row is part of the tree's roving focus, so one press of Tab leaves the tree.
links.label: Charge
links.title: Links

log.about: A log line as a structured logger writes it, with the error it caught. A `stack` string renders one frame per line.
log.label: Log line
log.title: A log line

previews.about: `maxPreviewItems` sets how many entries a collapsed branch lists, and `groupArraysAfterLength` splits a long array into branches of that length. The 120 events open as three groups of up to 50, each listing two entries.
previews.label: Event feed
previews.title: Previews

quoted.about: `quotesOnKeys` writes each key in quotes, as the JSON file writes it.
quoted.label: Package manifest
quoted.title: Quoted keys

secrets.about: `renderValue` replaces a leaf's value, which keeps its type's ink. The configuration masks each key and secret down to its prefix and its last four characters.
secrets.label: Service configuration
secrets.title: Masked values

size.about: Both steps of the code text style. The rows measure 24 and 32px, the tree view's `sm` and `md` rows.
size.title: Sizes

title: JSON tree view

types.about: One value of every type the tree renders: a string, a number, a bigint, a boolean, `null`, `undefined`, a date, a regular expression, a function, a map, a set, an error, a class instance, a typed array, a symbol and a URL. The error's message is in the error ink. `showNonenumerable` is off, so the function's source is not listed.
types.label: Values of every type
types.title: Types
